input.contents:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# elixir-phoenix Cursor hook adapter (v2.14.2)
#
# Bridges Cursor hook events to the upstream Claude Code shell scripts from
# github.com/oliver-kriska/claude-elixir-phoenix. Scripts self-gate on mix.exs,
# so this is safe to enable globally.
#
# Usage (from ~/.cursor/hooks.json): ./hooks/elixir-phoenix/adapter.sh <event>
#
# Compatible events:
#   beforeShellExecution  — block ecto.reset/drop + force-push; deps-audit gate
#   preToolUse            — freeze-gate (Write/StrReplace)
#   postToolUse           — format / iron-laws / debug / security (Write/StrReplace)
#   sessionStart          — setup dirs, detect Tidewave/Ash, resume hints
#   preCompact            — precompact rules reminder
#   stop                  — pending-plan reminder
#
# Not ported (Cursor lacks equivalent feedback channels):
#   route-intent (beforeSubmitPrompt cannot inject additional_context)
#   inject-iron-laws (subagentStart cannot inject context)
#   elixir-failure-hints / error-critic (postToolUseFailure has no output fields)
#   afterFileEdit feedback (informational only in Cursor)

set -u

EVENT="${1:-}"
HOOK_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
SCRIPTS="$HOOK_DIR/scripts"

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '{}' 
  exit 0
fi

INPUT=$(cat)
[ -n "$INPUT" ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }

# Project root: prefer Cursor workspace_roots[0], then cwd, then PWD
PROJ=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.workspace_roots[0] // .cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$PROJ" ] || PROJ="$PWD"
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PROJ"

run_script() {
  local name="$1"
  local stdin="$2"
  local timeout_s="${3:-30}"
  local script="$SCRIPTS/$name"
  [ -x "$script" ] || return 0
  # Capture stdout+stderr+exit without aborting the adapter
  local tmp_out tmp_err
  tmp_out=$(mktemp)
  tmp_err=$(mktemp)
  printf '%s' "$stdin" | "$script" >"$tmp_out" 2>"$tmp_err"
  local code=$?
  OUT=$(cat "$tmp_out")
  ERR=$(cat "$tmp_err")
  rm -f "$tmp_out" "$tmp_err"
  return $code
}

parse_deny() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | jq -r '
    .hookSpecificOutput
    | select(.permissionDecision == "deny")
    | (.permissionDecisionReason // "Blocked by elixir-phoenix hook")
  ' 2>/dev/null
}

parse_context() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext // empty' 2>/dev/null
}

# Map Cursor Write/StrReplace tool_input → Claude Edit/Write JSON
claude_edit_json() {
  local tool_name tool_input
  tool_name=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty')
  tool_input=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -c '.tool_input // {}')

  case "$tool_name" in
    Write)
      printf '%s' "$tool_input" | jq -c '{
        tool_name: "Write",
        tool_input: {
          file_path: (.path // .file_path // ""),
          content: (.contents // .content // "")
        }
      }'
      ;;
    StrReplace)
      printf '%s' "$tool_input" | jq -c '{
        tool_name: "Edit",
        tool_input: {
          file_path: (.path // .file_path // ""),
          old_string: (.old_string // ""),
          new_string: (.new_string // "")
        }
      }'
      ;;
    EditNotebook)
      printf '%s' "$tool_input" | jq -c '{
        tool_name: "Edit",
        tool_input: {
          file_path: (.target_notebook // .path // ""),
          new_string: (.new_string // "")
        }
      }'
      ;;
    *)
      # afterFileEdit payload
      printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -c '{
        tool_name: "Edit",
        tool_input: {
          file_path: (.file_path // ""),
          old_string: ((.edits // []) | map(.old_string // "") | join("\n")),
          new_string: ((.edits // []) | map(.new_string // "") | join("\n"))
        }
      }'
      ;;
  esac
}

emit_json() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1"
}

case "$EVENT" in
  beforeShellExecution)
    CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty')
    [ -n "$CMD" ] || { emit_json '{"permission":"allow"}'; exit 0; }
    CLAUDE=$(jq -nc --arg c "$CMD" '{tool_name:"Bash", tool_input:{command:$c}}')

    run_script "block-dangerous-ops.sh" "$CLAUDE" 10 || true
    DENY=$(parse_deny "$OUT")
    if [ -n "$DENY" ]; then
      CTX=$(parse_context "$OUT")
      jq -nc --arg r "$DENY" --arg a "${CTX:-$DENY}" \
        '{permission:"deny", user_message:$r, agent_message:$a}'
      exit 0
    fi

    # deps-audit-gate only for mix deps.*
    if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE 'mix[[:space:]]+deps\.'; then
      run_script "deps-audit-gate.sh" "$CLAUDE" 5
      code=$?
      if [ $code -eq 2 ] && [ -n "${ERR:-}" ]; then
        jq -nc --arg r "$ERR" \
          '{permission:"deny", user_message:$r, agent_message:$r}'
        exit 0
      fi
    fi

    emit_json '{"permission":"allow"}'
    ;;

  preToolUse)
    TOOL=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty')
    case "$TOOL" in
      Write|StrReplace|EditNotebook) ;;
      *) emit_json '{}'; exit 0 ;;
    esac
    CLAUDE=$(claude_edit_json)
    run_script "freeze-gate.sh" "$CLAUDE" 5 || true
    DENY=$(parse_deny "$OUT")
    if [ -n "$DENY" ]; then
      CTX=$(parse_context "$OUT")
      jq -nc --arg r "$DENY" --arg a "${CTX:-$DENY}" \
        '{permission:"deny", user_message:$r, agent_message:$a}'
      exit 0
    fi
    emit_json '{"permission":"allow"}'
    ;;

  postToolUse)
    TOOL=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty')
    case "$TOOL" in
      Write|StrReplace|EditNotebook) ;;
      *) emit_json '{}'; exit 0 ;;
    esac

    # Fast skip outside Elixir projects
    [ -f "$PROJ/mix.exs" ] || { emit_json '{}'; exit 0; }

    CLAUDE=$(claude_edit_json)
    FP=$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
    WARNINGS=()

    for s in format-elixir.sh iron-law-verifier.sh debug-statement-warning.sh security-reminder.sh; do
      run_script "$s" "$CLAUDE" 30
      code=$?
      if [ $code -eq 2 ] && [ -n "${ERR:-}" ]; then
        WARNINGS+=("$ERR")
      fi
    done

    if printf '%s' "$FP" | grep -qE '(^|/)plans/[^/]+/plan\.md$'; then
      run_script "plan-stop-reminder.sh" "$CLAUDE" 15
      code=$?
      if [ $code -eq 2 ] && [ -n "${ERR:-}" ]; then
        WARNINGS+=("$ERR")
      fi
    fi

    # Progress log (async / best-effort, ignore output)
    run_script "log-progress.sh" "$CLAUDE" 15 || true

    if [ ${#WARNINGS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
      CTX=$(printf '%s\n' "${WARNINGS[@]}")
      jq -nc --arg c "$CTX" '{additional_context:$c}'
    else
      emit_json '{}'
    fi
    ;;

  sessionStart)
    [ -f "$PROJ/mix.exs" ] || { emit_json '{}'; exit 0; }
    CTX_PARTS=()
    for s in setup-dirs.sh detect-tidewave.sh detect-ash.sh check-scratchpad.sh check-resume.sh check-branch-freshness.sh; do
      run_script "$s" "$INPUT" 30 || true
      # SessionStart scripts often print plain text or JSON context
      if [ -n "${OUT:-}" ]; then
        ctx=$(parse_context "$OUT")
        if [ -n "$ctx" ]; then
          CTX_PARTS+=("$ctx")
        elif [ -n "$OUT" ] && ! printf '%s' "$OUT" | jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          CTX_PARTS+=("$OUT")
        fi
      fi
      if [ -n "${ERR:-}" ]; then
        CTX_PARTS+=("$ERR")
      fi
    done
    if [ ${#CTX_PARTS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
      CTX=$(printf '%s\n' "${CTX_PARTS[@]}" | sed '/^$/d' | head -c 8000)
      jq -nc --arg c "$CTX" '{additional_context:$c}'
    else
      emit_json '{}'
    fi
    ;;

  preCompact)
    [ -f "$PROJ/mix.exs" ] || { emit_json '{}'; exit 0; }
    run_script "precompact-rules.sh" "$INPUT" 15 || true
    ctx=$(parse_context "$OUT")
    if [ -n "$ctx" ]; then
      jq -nc --arg c "$ctx" '{additional_context:$c}'
    elif [ -n "${ERR:-}" ]; then
      jq -nc --arg c "$ERR" '{additional_context:$c}'
    else
      emit_json '{}'
    fi
    ;;

  stop)
    [ -f "$PROJ/mix.exs" ] || { emit_json '{}'; exit 0; }
    STATUS=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.status // empty')
    if [ "$STATUS" = "error" ]; then
      run_script "stop-failure-log.sh" "$INPUT" 15 || true
    fi
    run_script "check-pending-plans.sh" "$INPUT" 15 || true
    ctx=$(parse_context "$OUT")
    if [ -n "$ctx" ]; then
      # Cursor stop uses followup_message, not additional_context
      jq -nc --arg m "$ctx" '{followup_message:$m}'
    elif [ -n "${ERR:-}" ] && [ "${ERR}" != "" ]; then
      jq -nc --arg m "$ERR" '{followup_message:$m}'
    else
      emit_json '{}'
    fi
    ;;

  *)
    # Unknown / unsupported event — fail open
    emit_json '{}'
    ;;
esac

# elixir-phoenix (Cursor adaptation)

Upstream: [oliver-kriska/claude-elixir-phoenix](https://github.com/oliver-kriska/claude-elixir-phoenix) **v2.14.2**

Installed for **Cursor** (global). Skills are Agent Skills; hooks are adapted from Claude Code's declarative format.

## What's installed

| Piece | Location |

| Skills (51) | `~/.agents/skills/{phx-*,ecto-*,…}` + symlinks in `~/.cursor/skills/` |

content.text: I'll adapt the 26 Claude agent defs into Cursor's `~/.cursor/agents/` format (name, description, model, readonly).

input.command:
mkdir -p ~/.cursor/agents
SRC=~/.agents/skills/plugins/elixir-phoenix/agents
DEST=~/.cursor/agents

# Convert each Claude agent → Cursor-compatible frontmatter + same body
python3 <<'PY'
import re, pathlib

src = pathlib.Path.home() / ".agents/skills/plugins/elixir-phoenix/agents"
dest = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cursor/agents"
dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Claude model → Cursor model
MODEL_MAP = {
    "haiku": "inherit",   # Cursor has no haiku slug; inherit parent
    "sonnet": "inherit",
    "opus": "inherit",
}

installed = []
for path in sorted(src.glob("*.md")):
    text = path.read_text()
    m = re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---\n(.*)$", text, re.S)
    if not m:
        print(f"SKIP (no frontmatter): {path.name}")
        continue
    fm_raw, body = m.group(1), m.group(2)

    # Parse simple YAML-ish frontmatter (enough for these files)
    fields = {}
    list_key = None
    list_vals = []
    for line in fm_raw.splitlines():
        if list_key and line.startswith("  - "):
            list_vals.append(line[4:].strip().strip('"').strip("'"))
            continue
        if list_key:
            fields[list_key] = list_vals
            list_key, list_vals = None, []
        if ":" not in line:
            continue
        key, _, val = line.partition(":")
        key, val = key.strip(), val.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if val == "":
            list_key = key
            list_vals = []
        else:
            fields[key] = val
    if list_key:
        fields[list_key] = list_vals

    name = fields.get("name") or path.stem
    description = fields.get("description") or f"Elixir/Phoenix specialist: {name}"
    claude_model = fields.get("model", "sonnet")
    cursor_model = MODEL_MAP.get(claude_model, "inherit")

    tools = [t.strip() for t in str(fields.get("tools", "")).split(",") if t.strip()]
    disallowed = [t.strip() for t in str(fields.get("disallowedTools", "")).split(",") if t.strip()]
    # readonly if Write is disallowed (or not in tools) AND Edit is disallowed
    has_write = "Write" in tools and "Write" not in disallowed
    readonly = not has_write

    skills = fields.get("skills") or []
    if isinstance(skills, str):
        skills = [skills]

    # Append skill hint to description for Cursor (no skills: frontmatter)
    if skills:
        skill_hint = ", ".join(skills)
        if "skills:" not in description.lower() and skill_hint not in description:
            description = f"{description} Related skills: {skill_hint}."

    # Build Cursor frontmatter
    lines = ["---", f"name: {name}", f"description: {description}", f"model: {cursor_model}"]
    if readonly:
        lines.append("readonly: true")
    lines.append("---")

    out = "\n".join(lines) + "\n" + body
    # Soften Claude-only path assumptions slightly at the top? Keep body intact —
    # skills/hooks already teach .claude/plans conventions which still work.

    out_path = dest / f"{name}.md"
    out_path.write_text(out)
    installed.append((name, "readonly" if readonly else "write", claude_model))

print(f"Installed {len(installed)} agents → {dest}")
for name, mode, cm in installed:
    print(f"  {name:28} {mode:8} (was {cm})")
PY

echo "---"
ls ~/.cursor/agents | wc -l
ls ~/.cursor/agents
# spot-check one
head -20 ~/.cursor/agents/elixir-reviewer.md
echo "..."
head -15 ~/.cursor/agents/call-tracer.md
